How to change the default browser in Windows: What to
check when links open in the wrong browser
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-11-08
Open the default apps screen in
Settings
Open the Settings app and go to Apps > Default
apps.
Set your preferred browser as the
default browser
Under Set defaults for applications, select the
browser, then click Set default next to 'Make
[browser name] your default browser.' Microsoft…
Check link formats and file types
separately
Even after setting the default browser, some
links may continue opening in another app if the
https or .html entries remain assigned to the…
Check these three things after
changing the setting
① Check whether the browser entry has changed on
the Default apps screen. ② Paste an https
address into Notepad or a messenger app and open…
